assertions.name: C1_positive_root_COUNTS_match_the_known_values
assertions.source: A1..A5, D4, D5, E6, E7, E8 all reproduce (10 checked); the generator is not inventing its own root systems

assertions.name: C2_every_generated_union_has_the_RANK_it_was_asked_for
assertions.source: so 'edges = rank - components' is applicable; ADE diagrams are trees, which is what makes the arrow count a function of the type alone

assertions.name: C3_the_enumeration_is_EXHAUSTIVE_at_each_rank
assertions.source: rank->#types {2: 2, 3: 3, 4: 6, 5: 9}: rank 2 gives A1+A1, A2; rank 3 gives A1^3, A1+A2, A3; rank 4 adds A2+A2, A1+A3, A4, D4. A target is therefore hit by exactly one type or by none — there is nothing to choose

assertions.name: every_reading_gives_a_UNIQUE_Dynkin_type
assertions.source: all four (rank, spectrum) pairs are hit by exactly one ADE type. The arrow count is not chosen — it is read off

assertions.name: if_the_abelian_connection_IS_a_node_there_are_ZERO_arrows
assertions.source: 4_1 -> A1+A1+A1 and 5_2 -> A1+A1+A1+A1, arrows {'4_1': 0, '5_2': 0}. This is exactly the potential-free ABELIANIZED quiver the corpus's M2 result said already realizes the target — reached here from Gabriel rather than from the plethystic log, which is an independent route to the same object

assertions.name: if_it_is_NOT_a_node_there_is_EXACTLY_ONE_arrow
assertions.source: 4_1 -> A2 and 5_2 -> A1+A2, arrows {'4_1': 1, '5_2': 1}. Both knots land on one arrow, so the two readings are each internally consistent across the two knots rather than one working and one not

assertions.name: SO_THE_ARROW_QUESTION_IS_ANSWERED_conditionally
assertions.source: the arrow count is FORCED to 0 or 1 by (rank, spectrum) alone, and which of the two depends only on whether the abelian connection is a node. That is a much smaller open question than 'what are the arrows', and it is a question about a CONVENTION the corpus already has an opinion about, not about new mathematics

assertions.name: WHAT_WOULD_BREAK_THIS
assertions.source: (A3) finiteness is load-bearing: an infinite BPS spectrum means non-Dynkin and nothing is forced. (A2) acyclicity is assumed. (A5) the recorded DT count must be the indecomposable count rather than a per-ray count — if the corpus's (4,3) are counts at two rays of ONE quiver, the total is >= 7 and rank 4 A1+A3 (7 roots, 2 arrows) becomes the candidate instead. That reading is NOT tested here

description: qou-q9ih D1-b, the arrow question. Answered by a counting argument rather than by searching quivers against the target (the fit D1-a showed cuts nothing). For an acyclic quiver with W=0, Gabriel's theorem says finite representation type <=> simply-laced Dynkin, and then #indecomposables = #positive roots. Every ADE diagram is a TREE, so a rank-V union with k components has exactly V-k edges: the arrow count is determined by the Dynkin type, and the type by (rank, #positive roots). The rank is the node count, which the companion probe made arithmetic; the corpus supplies the spectrum size. Exhaustive ADE enumeration at ranks 2-5, exact integer arithmetic. Both node readings are carried, since the corpus does not settle whether the abelian connection is a node. CONDITIONAL on a stated chain: W=0 (the corpus's M2 finding), acyclicity, FINITE spectrum (the load-bearing one), simply-lacedness, and that the recorded DT count is the indecomposable count. If the spectrum is infinite, Gabriel does not bite and nothing here is forced. Scope-(a); nothing wired; no fit.

assumption_chain.A1_W_zero: the corpus's M2 finding (AomegaM2BPSCohomology, lean-direct exit 0)
assumption_chain.A3_finite_spectrum: LOAD-BEARING; an infinite spectrum means non-Dynkin and nothing is forced
assumption_chain.A4_simply_laced: Gabriel covers quivers; B/C/F/G need valued quivers and are excluded, not overlooked
assumption_chain.A5_DT_count_is_indecomposable_count: if the corpus's (4,3) are per-ray counts of one quiver instead, the total is >=7 and A1+A3 becomes the candidate

scope.tier: scope-(a), conditional on the assumption chain
scope.method: exhaustive ADE enumeration + exact positive-root counts; no search against the target, no fit
